description: This file contains the implementation of schema generation and handling for higher-order operators in PyTorch, including classes for argument info, schema generation, and utility functions for extracting schemas from FX graphs.

classes.name: HopArgumentInfo
classes.description: Data class holding information about an argument for a higher-order operator, including name, example value, default value, mutation status, and keyword-only flag.

classes.name: HopArgumentInfoGen
classes.description: Class providing static methods to generate HopArgumentInfo instances from example values.

classes.name: CTypeGen
classes.description: Utility class for converting example objects to PyTorch C++ type representations.

classes.name: CArgumentGen
classes.description: Utility class for converting HopArgumentInfo into torch._C.Argument objects suitable for schema construction.

classes.name: HopSchemaGenerator
classes.description: Class for incrementally constructing a FunctionSchema for higher-order operators based on example inputs and outputs.

classes.name: CFunctionSchemaGen
classes.description: Class for generating FunctionSchema instances with invariants suitable for higher-order operator schemas, including flattening inputs and ensuring no aliasing.

classes.name: HopSchema
classes.description: Subclass of torch._C.FunctionSchema that includes a schema tree spec and supports deep copying.

methods.description: Creates torch._C.Argument objects from HopArgumentInfo, with consideration of whether it is an output argument.

methods.description: Method in HopSchemaGenerator to add an argument's info and validate it.

methods.name: None add_output(self, output: Any)
methods.description: Method to add example output(s) to the hop schema generator.

methods.name: None add_schema_tree_spec(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Stores the pytree tree spec of the flattened inputs for reconstructing argument structure.

methods.name: torch._C.FunctionSchema gen_schema(self)
methods.description: Generates a torch._C.FunctionSchema object representing the schema of the higher-order operator based on collected argument info.

methods.name: Any from_hop_argument_info( op_name: str, inp_argument_info: list[HopArgumentInfo], out_argument_info: HopArgumentInfo, schema_tree_spec: Optional[pytree.TreeSpec], )
methods.description: Static method to generate a HopSchema (which is a FunctionSchema subclass) from argument info and output info, enforcing invariants.
